title: An analysis of 10M job ads in China between 2021 and 2025 finds a double-digit decline in listings for roles more exposed to AI than for less-exposed positions (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: An analysis of 10M job ads in China between 2021 and 2025 finds a double-digit decline in listings for roles more exposed to AI than for less-exposed positions — A Bloomberg analysis finds a double-digit decline in hiring for jobs most exposed to the technology.
